dependencies.reason: Modifies sandbox/gatewayd's authentication, owner identity, registry removal path, logs and gwtest; every spec 19 test must keep passing unchanged.

tasks.title: Add Authenticator, Config.Authenticate and the exactly-one-mode rule to New
steps: Write TS-25-1..TS-25-5 in sandbox/gatewayd/config_auth_test.go (package gatewayd_test, named TestXxx_TS25_NN with a '// TS-25-NN: ... 25-REQ-x.y.' comment) and confirm they fail

In config.go add `type Authenticator func(ctx context.Context, token string) (principal string, ok bool)` with a doc comment and the field `Config.Authenticate Authenticator`, and a field on Server to hold it

In New, after the Backend nil check, refuse Tokens non-empty together with Authenticate non-nil, and refuse both unset (nil or empty Tokens), with an error naming `Config.Tokens` and `Config.Authenticate` and containing no token; return a nil *Server
When Tokens is set keep `fmt.Errorf("gatewayd: Config.Tokens: %w", token.Validate(...))` unchanged; when Authenticate is set skip token validation
Keep the Backend, limits, TLS and NetworkModes validation and error texts exactly as in spec 19, in the same order

Check that the existing TestNewRefuses_TS19_30 'no tokens' case still passes (still refused); if its asserted text is no longer produced, adapt only through the new error text being a refusal, never by editing the spec 19 test's expectations beyond what the PRD design decision 1 states
done_when: New returns a server for Config{Backend, Authenticate} and refuses both-set and neither-set configurations

tasks.title: Key ownership by principal string, add PrincipalFromContext and the refusal reason in static mode
steps: Write TS-25-6, 7, 8, 28, 32, 40 (external tests in sandbox/gatewayd; TS-25-28 parses the package's exported API with go/parser/go/doc) and confirm they fail

In auth.go replace `type owner [32]byte`/`ownerOf` with a principal string stored under an unexported context key; add exported `PrincipalFromContext(ctx) (string, bool)` reading it (false for any context the server did not make); export no function or key that puts a principal on a context

Static mode: authenticateMD still compares sha256 of the token against every configured hash with subtle.ConstantTimeCompare; the principal is hex.EncodeToString of the matching hash (64 lowercase hex); tap, unaryAuth and streamAuth all authenticate and put the principal on the context
Change entry.owner to a string and make lookup, access, list, relay.route, SyncGit and gatewayService.Destroy/List/Create use the principal string
Replace owner.fingerprint with a helper that logs the first 8 characters of the principal in static mode; logCreate takes the principal string; never log the full hash

Give refuse(ctx, reason) and logAuthRefused(peer, reason) a `reason` attribute: 'no token' for a missing, repeated, non-Bearer or empty header, 'refused' for no hash match; keep message 'authentication refused' and the peer attribute unchanged

Extend gwtest.Counting (internal/gwtest/backends.go) to record the (principal, ok) of PrincipalFromContext for every Create, Reap and sandbox Sync, with accessors CreatePrincipals(), ReapPrincipals(), SyncPrincipals() and a Principals() alias for the Create list
Run all spec 19 tests in sandbox/gatewayd unchanged and confirm they pass
done_when: Every spec 19 test in sandbox/gatewayd and its command passes without modification

tasks.title: Callback-mode authentication in the tap handle, with principal validation and panic recovery
steps: Write the ten tests and confirm they fail; TS-25-13 is an in-package test (package gatewayd, e.g. auth_internal_test.go) calling s.unaryAuth/s.streamAuth directly with a context carrying no principal
In gwtest.Start set Tokens to [Token, TokenB] only when both cfg.Tokens and cfg.Authenticate are unset
In auth.go callback-mode tap: read `authorization` with today's rules; a missing/repeated/non-'Bearer ' header or empty token is refused with reason 'no token' without calling the authenticator

Otherwise call the authenticator exactly once with the tap's ctx (carries the peer) and the token byte for byte, no server length or character rule, inside a func with defer recover(); a panic refuses with reason 'panic' and never logs the panic value

ok == false refuses with reason 'refused'; ok == true with an empty or >256-byte principal refuses with reason 'invalid principal'; every refusal is codes.Unauthenticated with errUnauthenticated, returned from the tap so no message is read and no handler or backend runs, also for unserved methods
On acceptance return context.WithValue(ctx, principalKey, principal) from the tap

In callback mode unaryAuth and streamAuth do not call the authenticator: they check the context carries a principal and otherwise refuse via refuse(ctx, 'refused') without running the handler; static mode keeps its second authentication
Tests: use a counting authenticator recording token and peer presence; check the backend sees the principal via Counting for 7.2; a 256-byte principal works and arbitrary bytes round-trip unchanged
done_when: A callback-mode server accepts exactly the tokens its authenticator accepts and refuses everything else before any message is read

tasks.title: Shared and foreign principals, revocation, and the principal on Sync and Reap contexts
steps: Write the seven tests (callback-mode servers over local through gwtest, revocable authenticator mapping several tokens to principals) and confirm which fail

Confirm SyncGit passes the RPC's principal-carrying context to the backend sandbox's Sync and the Gateway.Reap RPC passes its context to Backend.Reap; fix any place that rewraps or replaces the context
Confirm reapLoop (Serve start and each ReapInterval) still uses a context.Background()-derived timeout context with no principal

Confirm two tokens of one principal reach each other's sandboxes through List, relay, SyncGit and Destroy (destroy reason 'client'), and a different principal gets the spec 19 unknown-id answers: List omits, Destroy OK with no effect, relay and SyncGit codes.Unavailable naming the id (equal to the message for a random unknown id)
Revocation test: revoke a token while an execute is in flight; the execute finishes normally, later RPCs with that token are Unauthenticated, the sandbox stays visible to the other token
TS-25-44 runs the same client code (Create, List, relay tool call, Destroy) against a static-mode and a callback-mode gateway
TS-25-42 asserts Counting's CreatePrincipals/SyncPrincipals/ReapPrincipals pairs, including ('', false) for the periodic reap
done_when: Principal-keyed ownership holds in both modes with the spec 19 foreign-id answers

tasks.title: Log the principal and the refusal reason in both modes
steps: Write the seven tests using gwtest.NewLogs and Logs.Messages / Logs.String and confirm which fail
In log.go make logCreate log `owner` as the first 8 hex characters of the principal in static mode and as the full principal in callback mode (the mode is known from the Server's configuration)
Make sure every refusal path passes the right reason: 'no token', 'refused', 'invalid principal', 'panic'; the refusal record keeps Warn level, message 'authentication refused' and `peer`

Never log a token, the panic value, a full static-mode hash, a Spec.Env value or a tool payload; TS-25-27 plants strings in a token, a panic value, Env and a tool payload in both modes and asserts none appears in the captured output
Run TestLogging_TS19_35 and TestUnauthenticated_TS19_34 unchanged and confirm they pass
done_when: The refused-authentication line carries one of the four reason values and no log line holds a secret

tasks.title: Add (*Server).Destroy and ErrNotHeld with a context on the registry removal path
steps: Write the seven tests (a recording backend wrapper recording each sandbox Close context; Counting.SetAfterCreate for TS-25-36) and confirm they fail
Add `var ErrNotHeld = errors.New("gatewayd: sandbox not held")` and `reasonEmbedder = "embedder"` in log.go

Give registry.remove a ctx parameter used for e.sb.Close(ctx); every existing caller (prune, add's expiry timer, access, list, gatewayService.Destroy, closeAll and the Create error paths) passes context.Background(); entry deletion and timer stop happen before Close
Add an ownerless registry lookup by id returning the entry or nil

Add `func (s *Server) Destroy(ctx, id) error` beside Shutdown: not held (unknown, removed, before Serve, after Shutdown, create in progress) returns fmt.Errorf wrapping ErrNotHeld and naming the id without calling any backend method; held entry runs remove(ctx, e, reasonEmbedder)

Return the Close error wrapped with the id (%w so errors.Is/As reach it); if a concurrent removal wins after the lookup (remove reports it did nothing) return nil, with Close called exactly once overall
Doc comments for Destroy and ErrNotHeld state the semantics, that the embedder treats errors.Is(err, ErrNotHeld) as already gone, and that Close gets the caller's ctx

TS-25-31 checks Close contexts of client Destroy, expiry, unavailability, Shutdown and Create error paths have no principal, no deadline and are not cancelled; TS-25-37 races Server.Destroy with client Destroy/expiry under -race
done_when: After Server.Destroy a client sees exactly what it sees after TTL expiry

tasks.title: Keep the command in static mode, pin the exported surface and update the documentation
steps: Write TS-25-39 in sandbox/gatewayd/cmd/agentkit-gateway (run the command's run function in process with a --token-file, make a no-token and a wrong-token RPC, assert reasons 'no token' then 'refused', and that run.go sets Tokens and never mentions Authenticate)

Write TS-25-43: enumerate the exported identifiers of sandbox/gatewayd (including methods and struct fields) with go/parser against a golden list of the spec 19 surface kept under sandbox/gatewayd/testdata, assert the difference is exactly Authenticator, Config.Authenticate, PrincipalFromContext, (*Server).Destroy and ErrNotHeld, sandbox.ProtocolMinor == 2 and the proto .sha256 files match
Confirm run.go needs no change; do not touch gateway.proto, sandbox.proto, sandbox/gateway or internal/policy/testdata

Rewrite doc.go and the Config, Authenticator, PrincipalFromContext, Destroy and ErrNotHeld doc comments: the two modes, authenticator must be safe for concurrent use, return quickly without blocking, is trusted to compare tokens in constant time, and the principal must not be a secret
Run `make doc` to regenerate docs/generated/sandbox/gatewayd/gatewayd.txt and check it gains only the five identifiers

Update docs/configuration.md (Config table Authenticate row, exactly-one rule, paragraph on principal, PrincipalFromContext and Destroy), docs/api.md (sandbox/gatewayd row), docs/cli.md (refused line carries reason 'no token' or 'refused'), docs/architecture.md (Ownership paragraph speaks of principals plus a paragraph on the embedded gateway), and docs/errata/19_sandbox_gateway.md (callback mode differences to 19-REQ-5.3, 5.5, 5.7)
Do not write tests for docs content; run `make check`
done_when: `make doc` output differs from spec 19's only by the five identifiers and `make check` passes in every module

tasks.title: Verify the four execution paths end to end through real components
steps: Write TS-25-45..TS-25-48 as smoke tests (sandbox/gatewayd/smoke25_test.go) over gwtest's in-memory listener, gwtest.Counting and the sandbox/gateway client, and confirm they pass

Trace 25-PATH-1 from Config.Authenticate through the tap handle, the principal context value, gatewayService.Create, Backend.Create and logCreate to a relayed tool call; confirm each step calls the next and no stub remains

Trace 25-PATH-2 from (*Server).Destroy through registry.remove with reasonEmbedder to the backend Close with the caller's ctx and the client's sandbox_unavailable; trace 25-PATH-3 (shared principal, foreign principal, revocation) and 25-PATH-4 (static hex SHA-256 principal and 8-character owner log)

Confirm for each contract criterion that the producer is consumed in production code: PrincipalFromContext reads the key the tap and interceptors write; Authenticate is called from the tap in New's grpc.InTapHandle option; Destroy's ErrNotHeld is returned from production code
Search the touched files (sandbox/gatewayd/*.go, internal/gwtest, docs) for panic("not implemented"), TODO, and bare `return nil` on non-trivial paths, and remove any that remain
Run `make check` in every module and confirm spec 19 tests pass unchanged; do not run make check-release
done_when: `make check` passes in every module and all four smoke tests pass
